paraphrases.title: Fire-and-forget forEach leaves send(user) rejections unhandled
paraphrases.body: notifyAll calls send(user) inside forEach without awaiting, so a send(user) rejection is unhandled and lost to the caller. Await the promises. Proof: send(user) rejects while notifyAll resolves; unhandled on this head.

paraphrases.title: Lost errors: send(user) promise is unhandled
paraphrases.body: The per-user send(user) promise is never returned or awaited, so failures are unhandled rejections. Use Promise.all. Proof: send(user) rejection is unhandled here.

defective.note: The missing await is on notify.js:2. A blocking finding on line 2 counts; the text must name the concrete failure (send(user) rejection is unhandled/lost), not only "check this".
